expression: up = ((est_12m_sal_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_sal_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_sal_num, 1) + (est_12m_cps_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_cps_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_cps_num, 1) + (est_12m_dps_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_dps_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_dps_num, 1)) / 3; recs = (rec_raisednum_4wks - rec_lowerednum_4wks) / max(rec_num, 1); ebit = (est_12m_ebi_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_ebi_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_ebi_num, 1); group_rank(ts_decay_linear(rank(up) + rank(recs) + rank(ebit), 5), sector)

expression: up = ((est_12m_sal_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_sal_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_sal_num, 1) + (est_12m_cps_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_cps_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_cps_num, 1) + (est_12m_dps_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_dps_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_dps_num, 1)) / 3; recs = (rec_raisednum_4wks - rec_lowerednum_4wks) / max(rec_num, 1); m = (rank((est_12m_sal_mean - est_12m_sal_mean_4wks_ago) / abs(est_12m_sal_mean_4wks_ago)) + rank((est_12m_net_mean - est_12m_net_mean_4wks_ago) / abs(est_12m_net_mean_4wks_ago)) + rank((est_12m_pre_mean - est_12m_pre_mean_4wks_ago) / abs(est_12m_pre_mean_4wks_ago))) / 3; group_rank(ts_decay_linear(rank(up) + rank(recs) + if_else(is_nan(rank(m)), 0.5, rank(m)), 5), sector)
hypothesis: deu_3 plus how far the mean forecasts moved in 4 weeks (sales, net income, pre-tax; under 30 alphas each): size of revisions, not only how many analysts revised.

expression: up = ((est_12m_sal_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_sal_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_sal_num, 1) + (est_12m_net_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_net_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_net_num, 1) + (est_12m_pre_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_pre_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_pre_num, 1) + (est_12m_cps_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_cps_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_cps_num, 1) + (est_12m_dps_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_dps_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_dps_num, 1) + (est_12m_ebt_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_ebt_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_ebt_num, 1) + (est_12m_gps_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_gps_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_gps_num, 1)) / 7; recs = (rec_raisednum_4wks - rec_lowerednum_4wks) / max(rec_num, 1); group_rank(ts_decay_linear(rank(up) + rank(recs), 5), sector)
hypothesis: deu_2 (seven items, Sharpe 1.53, fitness 1.38) with recommendation breadth, the addition that lifted deu_3 above the bar.

expression: up = ((est_12m_sal_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_sal_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_sal_num, 1) + (est_12m_cps_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_cps_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_cps_num, 1) + (est_12m_dps_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_dps_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_dps_num, 1)) / 3; recs = (rec_raisednum_4wks - rec_lowerednum_4wks) / max(rec_num, 1); ebit = (est_12m_ebi_raisednum_4wks - est_12m_ebi_lowerednum_4wks) / max(est_12m_ebi_num, 1); m = (rank((est_12m_sal_mean - est_12m_sal_mean_4wks_ago) / abs(est_12m_sal_mean_4wks_ago)) + rank((est_12m_net_mean - est_12m_net_mean_4wks_ago) / abs(est_12m_net_mean_4wks_ago)) + rank((est_12m_pre_mean - est_12m_pre_mean_4wks_ago) / abs(est_12m_pre_mean_4wks_ago))) / 3; group_rank(ts_decay_linear(rank(up) + rank(recs) + rank(ebit) + if_else(is_nan(rank(m)), 0.5, rank(m)), 5), sector)
